spine.active_goal: Get Field Notes through its first Google Play review with a closed testing (Alpha) release, so the temporary name 'dev.satanshumishra.field_notes (unreviewed)' becomes "Field Notes" and the app stops being a Draft app. Per decision 01M4RZJMBA5A6245755SZ8KGWK (option B, owner 2026-10-12), the release sent for review is 1.0.1, whose Play bundle leaves sync out, so it needs no foreground service declaration. Sending for review happens only on the owner's yes.
spine.next_step: Get the owner's answers to three Play Console choices: how to clear the Internal testing rc.2 rollout (risk 01M4S7CHVNG1W4HVEN89WGHTD8), whether to fill the Advertising ID form with No (risk 01M4S7CHVNWGD45V9QYYMZEGBS), and whether to keep the 1.0.0 release notes on the Alpha 1.0.1 draft (risk 01M4S7CHVNMBYFNR8Q5AM9PPEG). Then, with the browser pane displayed, step through Policy and programs > App content > Data safety and check it describes a build with no sync (risk 01M4RZK5VJFWF5QWJ3BF15GEQR), choose Next on the Alpha draft, and Save. Send for review only on the owner's yes.
spine.last_session: 2026-10-12: walked Play Console read-only (pane hidden, no clicks). 1.0.1 replaced the 1.0.0 Alpha draft but kept the 1.0.0 notes; App access says no restrictions; App content needs the Foreground service declaration (rc.2 is live on Internal testing) and a new Advertising ID declaration. The Play variant's merged manifest has no foreground-service permission and no AD_ID. Data safety not yet read.

open_risks.text: Unverified: Play may still ask for the FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DATA_SYNC declaration after 1.0.1 if any other bundle still on a track requests it. The 1.0.0 AAB stays in the Alpha draft until 1.0.1 replaces it, and Internal testing holds an inactive draft, release 7 (1.0.0-rc.2), that probably requests it. Check App content and each track after the 1.0.1 upload. Discarding the rc.2 draft is the owner's call.

Unverified: a 1.0.1 upload with release status draft is expected to replace the 1.0.0 draft on Alpha. If it does, the saved en-US release notes need re-entering for 1.0.1. If it adds a second draft instead, the 1.0.0 draft needs discarding (owner's call).

WorkManager 2.11.0 is used only by the upload code (android/app/build.gradle.kts:70 implementation androidx.work:work-runtime). Its library manifest merges an untyped FOREGROUND_SERVICE permission and SystemForegroundService into any build that depends on it. The Play build must either drop the dependency (selfUpdate-only) or remove those entries with tools:node=remove, and the proof must read the merged manifest of the built AAB, not the source manifests.

Play Console's Data safety and App access answers may describe sync. After 1.0.1, check that they match a Play build with no sync; App access 'All functionality available without special access' becomes true.

After option B, every Android build made without -P fieldNotesSelfUpdate=true has no sync and no background uploads. That includes flutter run, debug and profile builds, the untagged CI APK and the owner's lab-kit builds (testkit build_manual.zsh, postmerge/build.zsh, device-pass build_android.zsh). Testing sync on Android needs -P fieldNotesSelfUpdate=true.

Verified 2026-10-12 in Play Console: App content still lists Foreground service permissions under Need attention, because Internal testing release 7 (1.0.0-rc.2) is Active as a full rollout to internal testers, not an inactive draft, and its bundle requests the permission. The 1.0.1 bundle (version code 12) does not: the Play variant's merged manifest at 05c12051 (same android/ and lib/ as tag v1.0.1 at 6b095878) has no FOREGROUND_SERVICE permission, no SystemForegroundService and no upload service. Clearing it needs the owner's choice: replace rc.2 on Internal testing with 1.0.1, pause Internal testing, or declare with the video.

Verified 2026-10-12: App content also lists the Advertising ID declaration under Need attention; Play says releases targeting Android 13 cannot be submitted until it is complete. The merged manifests of both Android builds carry no AD_ID permission and the app has no ads, so the answer is expected to be No. Filling and saving the form needs the owner's yes or the owner does it.

Verified 2026-10-12: the 1.0.1 upload replaced the 1.0.0 draft on Alpha (one Draft release 1.0.1), but its en-US release notes still hold the 1.0.0 text. The owner decides whether to keep them for testers' first Play release or replace them.
